title: Joel And Kerri — EN/DE/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: Afro-folk mbira acoustic guitar German French language learning warm baritone 104bpm brushed drums trilingual Zimbabwe-Australia family celebration
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Two worlds, one road.
Joel and Kerri — two homelands, one name.
Red dust and southern rain.
Getting it exactly right.

[Verse 2 - German, with English translations]
Zwei Welten, eine Straße. (Two worlds, one road.)
Joel und Kerri — zwei Heimatländer, ein Name. (Joel and Kerri — two homelands, one name.)
Roter Staub und südlicher Regen. (Red dust and southern rain.)
Genau richtig machen. (Getting it exactly right.)
Sie brachte den roten Staub mit sich (She brought the red dust with her)
In der Art, wie sie Fremde begrüßt. (In the way she says hello to strangers.)
Er war schon da, als sie ankam. (He was already there when she arrived.)
Sie bauten ein drittes Land. (They built a third country.)

[Chorus - French, with English translations]
Joel et Kerri (Joel and Kerri)
Poussière rouge et pluie du sud (Red dust and southern rain)
Joel et Kerri (Joel and Kerri)
Deux patries en un nom (Two homelands in one name)
Le mbira joue et les eucalyptus répondent (The mbira plays and the gum trees answer)
De Harare jusqu'à la lumière du port (From Harare to the harbour light)
Joel et Kerri (Joel and Kerri)
Exactement comme il faut (Getting it exactly right)

[Bridge - all three]
English: They built a third country — the one not on any map.
German: Sie bauten ein drittes Land — das auf keiner Karte zu finden ist. (They built a third country — not on any map.)
French: Ils ont construit un troisième pays — celui qui ne figure sur aucune carte. (They built a third country — not on any map.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Joel and Kerri — yes
German: Joel und Kerri — ja (Joel and Kerri — yes)
French: Joel et Kerri — oui (Joel and Kerri — yes)
